## Summary

`entire gossamer discover` scans `cwd` values found in Claude Code JSONL logs and resolves each to a git repo via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`. When a session was run inside a linked git worktree, that command returns the worktree's own directory rather than the original repo — so discover was suggesting tracking the worktree instead of the real repo.

Fixed in `src/commands/discover.rs`: added `resolve_main_root()`, which uses `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` (the same technique `status.rs::find_repo_for_cwd` already uses for linked-worktree detection) to find the shared `.git` directory and walk up to the main worktree root, canonicalizing to resolve any `..` segments. `scan_candidates` now uses this resolved root instead of the raw `--show-toplevel` output, so worktree-only sessions get attributed to the correct original repo directory.

Verified manually with a throwaway repo + linked worktree that the resolution lands on the main repo path, ran `cargo build --release` and the integration suite (17/18 pass; the one failure, `test_sessions_recent_filter_excludes_old_sessions`, is a pre-existing date-boundary flake reproducible on `main` before my change), and reinstalled via `cargo install --path .`.

there is a small bug in the session list navigation- if the session list if bigger than the viewport, and we scroll down, the highlighted session row is outside of the viewport, even though the list itself moves correctly

Found it — in `status.rs`'s sessions sub-screen, the scroll calculation counts the section's own header row as if it were available for entries. `sessions_h` (rows left for "Sessions" area) includes the "session / branch / author..." header row, but `scroll` is computed as if all of `sessions_h` were entry rows. That's off by one: the last visible entry index gets computed as still "in view" by the scroll math, while the header actually pushes it one row past the bottom of the viewport, so it gets `break`-ed out of the render loop without ever being drawn — the highlighted row disappears.

Only the pre-existing unrelated flake fails (already confirmed earlier to fail on clean `main`); all other 17 tests pass. Binary reinstalled.

## Summary

Bug was in `draw_sessions` (`src/commands/status.rs`), the sessions sub-screen you reach by drilling into a repo. `sessions_h` (rows left for the whole "Sessions" section) included the section's own column-header row ("session / branch / author / ..."), but the scroll offset was computed as if all of `sessions_h` were entry rows. That off-by-one meant the last entry near the viewport edge was judged "in view" by the scroll math but actually landed one row past `content_h`, so the render loop's `row >= content_h` check dropped it before drawing — the selection would scroll past the bottom of the visible list.

Fixed by reserving one row of `sessions_h` for the header before computing `scroll` (`entries_h = sessions_h.saturating_sub(1)`). The standalone `entire gossamer sessions` screen (`src/commands/sessions.rs`) already accounted for its header separately and didn't have this bug.
